issues.on_page: HUD capital fund grant (Contributions) 12,147.68; Loss on disposition of capital assets (2,630.90) (nonoperating)
issues.issue: The loss on disposition is printed among nonoperating revenues (expenses), but it was netted into other_financing with the capital contribution. That is defensible as a sale-of-assets item, and the arithmetic is right (12,147.68 - 2,630.90 = 9,516.78). A person could instead treat it as a nonoperating expense.
The extractor added '(nonoperating)' to the printed label. The amount 32.32 is correct.
